entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:1
segments: ¶"He who is emasculated by crushing or mutilation shall not enter the assembly of the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:2
segments: "One of illegitimate birth shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation none of his [descendants] shall enter the assembly of the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:3
segments: "An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter the assembly of the LORD; even to the tenth generation none of his [descendants] shall enter the assembly of the LORD forever,

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:4
segments: "because they did not meet you with bread and water on the road when you came out of Egypt, and because they hired against you Balaam the son of Beor from Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:5
segments: "Nevertheless the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, but the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:6
segments: "You shall not seek their peace nor their prosperity all your days forever.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:7
segments: "You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he [is] your brother. You shall not abhor an Egyptian, because you were an alien in his land.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:8
segments: "The children of the third generation born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:9
segments: ¶"When the army goes out against your enemies, then keep yourself from every wicked thing.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:10
segments: "If there is any man among you who becomes unclean by some occurrence in the night, then he shall go outside the camp; he shall not come inside the camp.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:11
segments: "But it shall be, when evening comes, that he shall wash with water; and when the sun sets, he may come into the camp.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:12
segments: "Also you shall have a place outside the camp, where you may go out;

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:13
segments: "and you shall have an implement among your equipment, and when you sit down outside, you shall dig with it and turn and cover your refuse.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:14
segments: "For the LORD your God walks in the midst of your camp, to deliver you and give your enemies over to you; therefore your camp shall be holy, that He may see no unclean thing among you, and turn away from you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:15
segments: ¶"You shall not give back to his master the slave who has escaped from his master to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:16
segments: "He may dwell with you in your midst, in the place which he chooses within one of your gates, where it seems best to him; you shall not oppress him.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:17
segments: "There shall be no [ritual] harlot of the daughters of Israel, or a perverted one of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:18
segments: "You shall not bring the wages of a harlot or the price of a dog to the house of the LORD your God for any vowed offering, for both of these [are] an abomination to the LORD your God.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:19
segments: "You shall not charge interest to your brother-interest on money [or] food [or] anything that is lent out at interest.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:20
segments: "To a foreigner you may charge interest, but to your brother you shall not charge interest, that the LORD your God may bless you in all to which you set your hand in the land which you are entering to possess.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:21
segments: "When you make a vow to the LORD your God, you shall not delay to pay it; for the LORD your God will surely require it of you, and it would be sin to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:22
segments: "But if you abstain from vowing, it shall not be sin to you.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:23
segments: "That which has gone from your lips you shall keep and perform, for you voluntarily vowed to the LORD your God what you have promised with your mouth.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:24
segments: "When you come into your neighbor's vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes at your pleasure, but you shall not put [any] in your container.

entries.title: Deuteronomy 23:25
segments: "When you come into your neighbor's standing grain, you may pluck the heads with your hand, but you shall not use a sickle on your neighbor's standing grain.
